This is communication practice, not trade training, a work method, an equipment authorization, a load calculation, an electrical or excavation procedure, a safety determination, or a legal approval. Contract terms, roles, permits, and inspection authority depend on applicable arrangements. No image or recording has been acquired; picture games remain disabled until suitability is reviewed.

image.brief: A realistic corroded component recorded for assessment, without a repair recommendation.
